ASG-SI (and the project's own design) assumes a stationary verifier-backed replay; RQGM's premise is that this goes stale as capability grows. The challenge is mild - the fix is a versioning discipline, not an architecture change.

Library drift is the failure mode the lifecycle pattern exists to prevent, now isolated with reproducible triggers: without outcome-driven retirement the library accumulates dead weight; the lifecycle is not optional polish.

The Phase 4 skeleton induces and retires; Library Drift adds two missing mechanisms - a BOUNDED active-cap (hard limit on live skills, not just utility ranking) and a meta-skill authoring prior - and warns that premature retirement is actively harmful (-0.019), so retirement must be outcome-driven, not age-driven.

The run-175 retention API (utility_score, prune with a grace window, record_use(helped)) is exactly outcome-driven lifecycle management; Library Drift is its published justification and argues the grace window should be generous (premature retirement -0.019 vs no injection +0.002).

Per-skill contribution scores + attribution verdicts + router-engagement metrics is Skill Lift measured continuously per library entry rather than once at promotion - the same 'measure the artifact's added value, not its shape' principle.

CER's training-free memory buffer accumulates trajectories; Library Drift says unbounded accumulation silently degrades retrieval and injects false positives. CER's +51% is real but contingent on the buffer not drifting - a bounded active-cap and outcome-driven eviction are prerequisites at scale.

'False-positive injections' from an unmanaged library is the non-adversarial analogue of memory poisoning: no attacker, just a low-value skill that keeps getting retrieved and mis-routed - and it persists the same way until an outcome-driven process evicts it.

The append-only evidence log with per-skill contribution scores that 'makes the failure visible before it reaches end-task scores' is a Phase 0 trace-substrate application - the leading indicator the substrate is meant to provide.

The 930k-PR integration-friction result (half the variance is repository-level, ICC 0.30 vs 0.16 agent vs human) is a large-N empirical instance of exactly one of the CAS theory's predicted ecosystem-level emergent properties - it moves the theory from position paper toward confirmed.

Direct support for the emergence-first family: behaviour that only appears in the population (repository-level friction agents each pass their tests but still create) is not visible to component-level evaluation - study the system, not the agent in isolation.

'Govern at the ecosystem level, not one agent at a time' is concept_irreversibility_budget's 'fleet-level budget, not a per-act check' arrived at independently from 930k real PRs - the outer gate belongs at the aggregate, because that is where the accumulating cost lives.

The CAS framing's micro-variables + coarse-graining functions is a measurement apparatus for the swarm layer of the three-layer emergence stratification - it operationalises 'emergence at the swarm layer' with Holland's properties and a causal-emergence metric.

A named theory (complex adaptive systems) plus seven falsifiable propositions for the emergence-first approach in the software-engineering domain - the method the project has been applying, given a literature frame and a falsification program.

If agent contributions degrade the ecosystem even when each passes its own held-out check (architectural entropy, comprehension debt), then a per-edit held-out regression gate is necessary but not sufficient - a self-improving loop also needs an ecosystem-level (repo-level) drift metric, which is Library Drift's per-skill contribution log one level up.

A solvable mechanism behind some MAST failure modes: two agents that each 'work' individually settle into a biased joint equilibrium neither intends, with the bias predictable from the objective gap - not a bug in either agent, a property of the coupled dynamics.

A candidate mechanism for herding: when agents update from each other's visible outputs under slightly different objectives, the coupled dynamics pull toward a shared biased fixed point rather than each agent's target - which is why hiding vote tallies helps.

Nuance: LLM-agent markets don't converge to the human equilibrium, but in a setting simple enough to solve exactly, misaligned agents DO converge - to a predictable BIASED fixed point. 'No convergence' may be 'convergence to the wrong point' plus noise.

The adversarial regime - one agent converges exactly while inducing persistent bias in the other - is a communication-layer attack expressed mechanistically: the channel itself, not a payload, is the exploit.
A rare mechanistic (closed-form) result at the swarm layer of the three-layer stratification - most swarm-layer evidence is phenomenological; this one links prompt geometry to joint stability.

A 164-work + 100-practitioner-record synthesis restating the model-harness-coupling frame: the six coupled runtime responsibilities are exactly the monograph's dependency-chain layers (harness / execution state / retrieval / memory / verification / observability).

'Improvements at one layer often fail to propagate to end-to-end outcomes' and 'weaknesses in one layer can invalidate downstream conclusions' is the per-layer-regression / non-propagation problem, confirmed across a large evidence base - the project's deterministic no-LLM per-layer check is the response.

'Evaluated as models but deployed as systems' is 'capability is a model-harness-configuration property, not a base-model property' stated as an operations problem: many apparent model failures originate in the configuration.

Same shape one level in: the monograph says reliability is a system (not model) property for a single agent; Govern the Repository says risk is an ecosystem (not agent) property for a population. System-level and ecosystem-level, both above the component.

'Weaknesses in task construction can invalidate downstream conclusions' names exactly the held-out-set risks the project has already patched (search contamination run 166, format-repair run 194) - the monograph's 206-record catalog is a checklist for the remaining task-construction gaps.

The monograph's explicit 'repair asymmetry across the agent lifecycle' framework is recoverability-as-a-constraint from the operations side: some layers are cheap to repair, others propagate damage that is expensive or impossible to undo - so evolution must be gated on the expensive-to-repair ones.

A canonical runtime action object with approval binding and receipt integrity is pattern_evidence_carrying_termination at the action granularity: a typed certificate binding the act to the evidence that authorised it, reproducible by an independent verifier.
'Approval binding' formalises the four-field constraint's AUTHORITY and PREREQUISITE fields as a runtime object: the approval is recorded, bound to the execution, and portable across runtimes.

The direct defence: a laundered 'I was allowed to X' fabricated in memory cannot produce a bound approval receipt an independent verifier can reproduce. CAVA's approval-binding + receipt-reproducibility tests are the check emergent_authorization_laundering says the gate needs.

exec_guard is a narrow pre-commit instance; CAVA is the general form - a runtime-portable canonical action object with attestation - the direction Phase 5 would grow if it moved from a git hook to a real runtime boundary.

Canonicalization and attestation are runtime responsibilities: CAVA explicitly places the stable action object below the mutable governance process - the runtime-as-fixed-point split, in the action layer.

CAVA's wrapper-bypass and attestation-tamper-detection benchmark axes are the action-layer analogue of tamper_audit.py's lineage check - both ask whether the record of what happened can be trusted against an adversary inside the system.

PCAA is the route-review-prove process; CAVA is the stable canonical action object that process governs. PCAA's replay-ready proof requires CAVA's reproducible action identity underneath - the two papers are explicitly one stack.

The five checkpoints plus 'what action, under whose AUTHORITY, with what approval semantics (FALLBACK / enforceability class), with what evidence (CONSEQUENCE / outcome closure), admissible given what PREREQUISITE' is the four-field constraint expressed as a runtime protocol.

The externality-aware certificate carries destination visibility and account provenance as first-class boundary facts - exactly the inputs concept_irreversibility_budget needs to price an act against a fleet-level budget rather than guess at reversibility.

Adds structure the project's typed certificate does not yet have: five distinct lifecycle checkpoints (not just termination), assumption capture as its own checkpoint, and replay-ready proof bound to a portable envelope.
'Approval' and 'outcome closure' are terminal checkpoints on the action, not on the reasoning - gate the act and its recorded outcome, which is principle_terminal_gate_only at runtime granularity.

'Enforceability classes rather than a single reviewed/unreviewed bit' is a direct structural response to concept_overseer_degradation's finding that user permission policies are 20.1pp weaker than per-action review - it makes the strength of an approval explicit and machine-checkable.

'The gate can only SELECT among behaviors the frozen base already produces' is the emergence-first thesis stated as an architectural constraint: capability is elicited/selected, not trained in - and SEA's own result (base capability is the dominant confound-free effect) is the evidence for it.

PACE gives the anytime-valid commit gate; SEA embeds it in a full architecture - a frozen base, a steering adapter, a versioned harness, five verifier-in-the-loop signal sources, and an auditable certificate against a fixed error budget.
The frozen base + fixed error budget + auditable certificate is SEAL's exogenous acceptance signal made concrete: the thing the modification is judged against is not producible by the modification.

The fifth independent arrival at the project's plan (after ASG-SI, Self-Harness, SEAL, Falsifiable Release Gates) - and the one matching the emergence-first / no-weight-training fork most exactly: steering adapter + versioned harness + frozen base.
SEA's 'auditable certificate against a fixed error budget' for each accepted self-modification is PCAA's action certificate applied to the self-improvement edit as the governed action.

SEA's headline empirical finding - base capability is the dominant, confound-free effect, harness suite contributes +4/+5 - is a clean confound-controlled measurement of the capability = model-x-harness-config decomposition on SWE-bench Verified.

SEA's five verifier-in-the-loop mechanisms (best-of-N, micro-step search, reproduction oracles, search-layer control, self-repair) supplying a dense grader-free signal from the issue text alone is inference-time scaling of verification, instantiated as the signal source for the gate.
SEA states the same caution against itself - 'results are single-run on expensive evaluations; confirming run-to-run variance is future work' - the Fragility discipline, self-applied.

Operationalises MAST with per-mode recovery rates on a real Claude agent: tool faults ~1.0, ambiguous delegation ~0.30, three latent/semantic modes ~0.0 - and the ORDERING is model-invariant (Sonnet/Opus/Haiku), which makes it a structural property of the modes, not a model artefact.

'Where a cascade began' and 'detection and attribution are necessary for containment' is precisely what the Phase 0 trace substrate + topology_recover.py exist to provide - cascade radius and origin attribution are trace-substrate outputs.

The trusted-state repair ablation - containment gains come from the trusted-state signal, not autonomous detection - is direct evidence that a purpose-built recovery mechanism (a retained trusted state) is load-bearing, not optional polish.

Three MAST modes never recover autonomously and blind retry just reproduces them - the agent does not act on the latent fault it is in. The recognition-execution gap, at the multi-agent recovery layer.
Gives the cascade a measured growth law: cascade radius rises from mean 0.9 to 4.7 as pipeline depth goes 3 to 7 - deeper decomposition is strictly more dangerous per unbounded fault.

SEA lists 'self-repair' as one of its five verifier-in-the-loop signal mechanisms; OrchestraBench shows blind retry / self-repair reproduces latent faults and delays detection unless paired with attribution and a trusted-state signal - self-repair alone is not a containment mechanism.

A concrete domain (incident response, 348 trials) where multi-agent decisively beats single-agent (100% vs 1.7% actionable, zero variance) - a counterweight to MAST's 'MAS gains often minimal'. The resolution is task-structure dependence, recorded as a tension not a refutation.
Evidence for the orchestration-first family in at least one production domain - but narrow (single domain, promotional framing), so a weak support edge.

Consistent with 'orchestration can beat the strongest model': here the mechanism is a deterministic synthesis step over specialised diagnostic agents (not a vote), which sidesteps the herding failure mode entirely.

OrchestraBench finds latent/semantic failure modes never recover; this reports ZERO quality variance over 348 trials. Either incident response avoids those modes by task structure, or the promotional framing is over-claiming - a tension worth resolving with the DQ metric details.

'MAS gains often minimal' is conditional: minimal when the recombination is a vote or a consensus discussion (most of MAST's modes live at recombination), substantial when subtasks are verifiable and synthesis is deterministic.

Hiding authorship and vote tallies is one instance of the general rule: agents must not see each other's partial reasoning. A deterministic synthesis step over disjoint-evidence agents is the clean form - no votes to hide.

OrchestraBench's never-recovering latent/semantic modes are recombination failures: they arise when one agent's flawed partial output is silently absorbed by another. A deterministic synthesis step with per-subtask verification is where they get caught.

Incident response is the positive case: decompose (triage / correlate / diagnose) into checkable subtasks, recombine by a deterministic recommendation synthesis - so the domain win is predicted by the criterion, not an anomaly.
Condition (c) IS structural decoupling: agents on disjoint evidence / context slices. Without it, multiplying agents just multiplies correlated errors (concept_epistemic_sybil_collapse).

Epistemic Sybil collapse is the failure when condition (c) is violated (shared evidence); the criterion says decoupled evidence + deterministic synthesis avoids it, and evidential-ancestry tracking is how you verify the decoupling held.

Gives the orchestration-first family a scoping condition instead of an unconditional claim: it is the right approach for verifiable-decomposable tasks with deterministic synthesis, and the wrong one for open-ended consensus reasoning.

The criterion is falsifiable with the project's own tools: topology_recover.py + the trace schema can measure subtask verifiability, synthesis determinism, and evidence disjointness on a real swarm trace and predict whether the orchestration helped - a concrete Phase 6 probe design.

improvement_loop.paired_eprocess (run 220) implements PACE's anytime-valid paired commit test as an advisory field in verify_loop_edit's evidence - the one adoptable code change from the runs 203-214 acceptor cluster. Advisory pending a multi-measurement held-out re-run; selftested (all-wins commits, 50/50 noise and a single win do not).

The rig operationalises the criterion's three conditions as sim knobs and finds a&b&c is strictly the best of the 8 combos (+0.52 vs single) while every combo missing one condition is <=+0.20 - the criterion is load-bearing at these params, not a post-hoc description.
Emits a swarm-layer trace via the Phase 0 Recorder that validates - the same substrate that would measure (a)/(b)/(c) on a real multi-agent run when one exists.

The (c)-off arm models epistemic Sybil collapse directly: a poisoned shared fact drags multiple subtasks and an independent-retry verifier does not fix it because the retry agent reads the same pool - the rig shows this erases the orchestration benefit.

The (b)-off arm charges a vote/consensus synthesis a BASE_HERD failure plus per-disagreement cost - the rig shows a vote-synthesis config never strongly beats single-agent even with verifiable disjoint subtasks.
A concrete Phase 6 (swarm-layer) probe design: the criterion is falsifiable with a real multi-agent harness by swapping _subtask_ok / _synthesis_ok for agent runs.

The seven canonical subsystems mapped across 11 production harnesses ARE the model-harness-coupling decomposition (observation / context / control / action / state / verification + extension), empirically grounded in ~4M lines of real code rather than a survey abstraction.

'None of eleven production harnesses retrieves code with vector embeddings - the field runs on deterministic retrieval' directly validates experience_bank's substring/key retrieval as the mainstream choice, not a shortcut - a vector index would be the outlier.

The longitudinal finding 'behavioral policy migrating from prompt prose to configuration' is the field independently doing what emergent_constraint_weakening_at_handoffs argues for: prose weakens in transit, configuration does not - context/loop_policy is a config component for this reason.

SKILL.md skills lead MCP in adoption (9/11 vs 8/11) - the skill-as-externalised-procedural-knowledge pattern is the dominant extension surface in production, which is what the lifecycle pattern assumes.
Omnigent, 'the first meta-harness', analysed here as a contrast point - the self-improving-harness family now has a shipped production instance in the corpus, not only research prototypes.

Gives the run-of-2026-09 'what the shipping harnesses converged on' observation a source-diffed longitudinal basis: convergence is real and is 'becoming imitation' - the same 29 patterns re-appearing across systems over a quarter.

'Convergence becoming imitation' across eleven production harnesses is diversity erosion at the ecosystem level - if every harness copies the same 29 patterns, the structural decoupling that keeps a multi-harness system diverse is quietly disappearing.

A harness with seven subsystems each spanning a minimal-to-maximal implementation range is exactly 'capability is a model-harness-config property' - the same model in a minimal vs maximal harness is a different agent.

The coding-specific instance of the general what/when/how/where taxonomy: 'targets of evolution' (framework / memory / skills+tools / components / workflow+topology / environment+context) is the 'what', specialised, and 'which code-specific signals' names executable feedback as the 'how'.

'Executable feedback + repository context + coding trajectories make SWE a natural domain for self-evolution' is the positive form of the horizon-gap argument: code gives a dense verifiable step signal that open-ended tasks lack.

'Reversibility' is named as one of seven shared challenges of self-evolving coding agents - the survey-level confirmation that recoverability-as-a-constraint is a field concern, not a project idiosyncrasy.

'Feedback reliability' and 'benchmark overfitting' - two of the survey's seven challenges - are exactly what the runs 203-214 acceptor cluster (SEAL / PACE / Who Grades the Grader / search-contamination) addresses.
Companion Aug-2026 synthesis: the harness-anatomy paper maps the SUBSYSTEMS a coding harness has; this survey maps how each subsystem gets EVOLVED - the static and dynamic views of the same object.

'Benchmark overfitting' as a named challenge includes search-time contamination: a web-connected coding agent re-run on a benchmark can retrieve the fix - the survey confirms this is a recognised field-level failure mode, which holdout_tasks.SEARCH_SENSITIVE already guards against.

Same stance (frozen base, evolve the harness/skills, no weight training) in a different domain: SEA does it for coding, SHAPER for embodied fixed-interface tasks. The frozen-base fork now has cross-domain support.

'Skill-and-harness optimization is a practical route to self-evolving agents when model training is expensive, unavailable, or undesirable' - the emergence-first / no-training thesis, argued from the constraint side (fixed robot interfaces).

'The same frozen model serves as both planner and optimizer' is the project's loop structure exactly - Claude proposes edits to its own harness - now demonstrated in embodied rollouts, not just coding traces.
SHAPER's 'context-code harness' = ACE's evolving context playbook plus the executable glue an embodied agent needs; context evolution generalised from text tasks to action interfaces.

Reusable skills evolved through rollouts and reused across a target environment - the skill lifecycle in the embodied setting, where the skill is a parameterised motion/subtask rather than a text procedure.

SHAPER beats test-time-scaling baselines (verifier-free selection, voting) - persistent skill/harness evolution outperforms spending the same inference budget on selection at decision time, at least in fixed-interface embodied settings. A mild tension: WHERE to spend the compute.

docs/harness_anatomy_self_audit.md (run 225) maps the project's tools/ to the seven canonical subsystems and checks all four headline empirical findings (no framework / deterministic retrieval / SKILL.md leads MCP / prose->config) against the project - all four validate a choice already made. Two gaps surfaced: no explicit action/tool subsystem, and no observability aggregation (loop_metrics computes signals but nothing rolls them up per run).

The monograph's dependency chain names observability as a link that can invalidate downstream conclusions. Run 226 closes the project's open observability gap (found in the run-225 self-audit): loop_metrics.status_line renders plateau_watch / idle_run_streak / trace_legibility / verified_citation_fraction / this-run trace-validity + graph-delta into one health line (light circle / half circle / filled circle), stamped into every run-<N>.json by loop_session._write_summary and printable via 'python tools/loop_metrics.py status'. 3 new selftest checks.

A working small-scale instance: the LLM proposes and explains (a JSON certificate of claimed constraint satisfaction), a deterministic verifier that recomputes every constraint is the authority, and only verifier-checked certificates are accepted - grounded acceptance, with numbers (98.55% pass, 0.021 NDCG drop).

The JSON certificate + deterministic re-check + constrained-greedy repair loop yielding an auditable trace is evidence-carrying termination with an explicit REPAIR stage - the certificate is not just checked, a failed check triggers a deterministic fix and re-verification.
PCAA's action certificate at the recommendation-slate granularity: a structured certificate of claimed policy satisfaction, verifier-checked, with the repair trace as the replay-ready proof.

Two negotiating agents (User Advocate / Policy Agent) whose outputs are recombined by a DETERMINISTIC verifier + constrained-greedy repair - conditions (a) verifiable and (b) deterministic-synthesis of the run-218 criterion, and it wins (98.55% vs a one-shot baseline).

The Policy Agent enforces governance constraints that are configuration, not model behaviour - a config-driven control plane for a HITL-style multi-agent recommendation loop, with the deterministic verifier as the enforcement point.

'An independent finite reference semantics agrees with execution on every outcome across all 528 executable questions' - a deterministic checker fully replaces ~3000 tokens of LLM lifecycle reasoning. The project's deterministic checks (exec_guard, graph validate, tampering_flags) are the right instinct: don't ask the model to reason about a change's effects, execute the check.

The registry supports exact revert of a single component, but the loop still REASONS about whether a component edit is safe before making it. CordisBench says that reasoning degrades as the harness grows - so the loop needs a deterministic dependency/teardown checker, not just a rollback, once the harness has more than a handful of coupled components.

'Predict state after a specified teardown order' is the recoverability question: recovery is not just re-pinning a body, it is restoring dependent state in the right order - and models are worst exactly here.

Teardown / cleanup reasoning is skill RETIREMENT: which downstream retrievals and routes a retired skill leaves dangling. Library Drift says premature retirement is harmful; CordisBench says the model can't reliably reason about what a retirement breaks - so retirement must be outcome-gated and deterministically checked.

'Reasoning across teardown ORDERS' and 'conditions that hold under ALL vs SOME orders' is the task-order-dependence problem inside the harness itself - the order components are torn down changes the outcome, and models are unreliable about it.

The project's three-loop runs between runs (observe-trace -> proposal -> held-out regression, once per run). PILOT runs the supervisor DURING the run - the middle loop as a live process, aborting a doomed worker instead of scoring it afterward. A distinct architectural claim, not just a faster cadence.

'A separate supervisor redirects or ABORTS the active worker during execution' is live recoverability - stop the trajectory before it commits an unrecoverable act, rather than reverting afterward. The strongest form of recoverability-as-a-constraint.
Two FROZEN backbones (GLM-5.1, Kimi-K2.6), harness-level improvement only - the frozen-base fork, now with a live supervisor-worker variant alongside SEA (coding) and SHAPER (embodied).

PILOT is a supervisor-worker topology; the project's subagent-coordination probe studies same-parent-ID scope bounding in that topology. PILOT adds the missing capability the probe assumes away: a supervisor that can redirect an active subagent.
'Live self-evolution distils procedures and failure modes revealed during execution into reusable skills and memory' - the skill lifecycle running mid-trajectory, not from a post-run trace sweep.
Long-horizon runs where outcome-only signals decay: PILOT manufactures a dense in-run signal (the supervisor's continuous assessment) - the same 'denser step-level signal' response, applied live.

The strongest published form: DeepSeek-V4-Flash + JIT-Agent SURPASSES GPT-5.6 on two benchmarks, and JIT-generated harnesses match Claude Code / OpenCode - a weaker model in a better harness beats a stronger model in a worse one, measured across multiple families.

A real alternative to the no-weight-training fork: JIT-Agent TRAINS a dedicated harness-generator model and shows harness intelligence is trainable, transferable, and COMPOUNDING - the project declines weight training, so if JIT-Agent's compounding claim holds, elicitation-only harness improvement may plateau where a trained generator does not.

JIT-Agent governs the harness with a FIXED FOUR-MODULE PROTOCOL so a generated harness is well-formed and comparable - the same move as pattern_four_field_constraint: a fixed schema that makes an artifact machine-checkable and prevents a free-form edit from shedding structure.

'JIT-Agent-generated harnesses are performance-competitive with OpenCode and Claude Code' - a generated harness reaching production-runtime quality is the tool-to-platform turn taken one step further: the platform generates itself.

'Self-evolve by distilling performance signals from an expanding archive of prior harness configurations' is recursive meta-skill evolution with the meta-object being the whole harness and a trained model doing the distillation, not a prompt loop.

JIT-Agent lists 'repair harnesses for stable and reliable execution' as a trained capability - the same explicit REPAIR stage PCN-Rec makes deterministic; two independent arguments that a self-improvement loop needs a repair step, not only accept/revert.

improvement_loop.deterministic_repair (run 232) is PCN-Rec's constrained-greedy repair on the project's synthetic Phase-3 task: a rejected proposal gets a bounded deterministic fix (pin the risk-protected classes, no blast-radius widening) and is re-verified before promotion. Motivated jointly by PCN-Rec, CordisBench (2609.01600), and JIT-Agent (2608.25593), which all name a repair stage. 4 new selftest checks.

CordisBench's finding - a deterministic reference semantics beats LLM lifecycle reasoning - is why the run-232 repair is DETERMINISTIC (a fixed rule: pin the protected classes) rather than a model call: the repair must be cheap and provably conservative.

JIT-Agent trains a repair capability; the project's run-232 repair is the deterministic, no-training counterpart - the same 'a loop needs repair, not only accept/revert' conclusion reached under the emergence-first constraint.
AHE is the anchor of the subfield node's citation graph, now opened directly - the 'falsifiable contract per edit' shared shape it names is what 20+ later systems converge on.

The project's build, published and measured: three observability pillars = Phase 1 (file-level revertible components) + Phase 2 (distilled evidence corpus) + Phase 3 (prediction per edit); 69.7->77.0% over 10 iterations, beating the human harness.

'Component observability: every editable component gets a file-level representation so the action space is explicit and revertible' is harness_registry's design goal, validated by an independent group with pass-rate numbers.
+5.1 to +10.1pp cross-family gains from a FROZEN evolved harness across three model families - the harness config carries capability that is not model-specific.

AHE's ablation: the gain localizes to tools / middleware / long-term memory, NOT the system prompt - 'factual harness structure transfers while prose-level strategy does not'. Direct support for context/loop_policy being config, and a steer to put self-improvement effort into structure not prompts.

Another independent arrival at the project's plan (with SEA, Self-Harness, SEAL, Release Gates): AHE's 'every edit a falsifiable contract' + revertible components + verified prediction is the project's Phase 1-3, reached separately in April 2026.

The sharpest EMPIRICAL challenge to the no-weight-training fork, and on SMALL models: harness-only optimization is bottlenecked by the frozen model, and on some tasks (math) the ceiling cannot be crossed without a weight update. Harness-only wins where the task is elicitation-shaped (SearchQA, cheaply), loses where it is capability-shaped.

Two independent Aug-2026 results that training (of weights, of a harness generator) beats a purely frozen approach - together they make the run-234 severity-6 concern (a trained alternative to the no-training fork) a small cluster, not one paper.

The coupling IS the finding: 'weight updates change which harness is effective, harness updates change which model capabilities are exposed'. WHALE operationalises the model-harness coupling as an alternating optimisation and shows neither side can be frozen without cost.

Confirms the harness carries real capability (harness search matches peak weight-only accuracy in SearchQA) while also showing it is not the WHOLE story - capability is a model-x-harness product, and WHALE optimises both factors.

ACE evolves context playbooks (no weights); WHALE's point is that 'existing joint-adaptation methods optimize weights and textual prompts but leave the broader harness fixed' - and that context/prompt evolution alone leaves the executable harness (tools, middleware, control flow) on the table.

docs/emergence_first_posture.md (run 237) now names the no-weight-training bet explicitly and states the WHALE / JIT-Agent evidence against it: harness-only elicitation is bottlenecked by the frozen model on capability-shaped tasks. The affordance-over-constraint principle assumes room + a frozen model is enough to elicit the interesting behaviour; WHALE says on some task shapes it is not.

ASPIRE tests moving research-direction-setting INTO the agent (a vague goal, hidden eval) and finds it hard - search collapses into goal interpretation and self-checks are over-trusted. Direct evidence that the top-of-hierarchy human bottleneck is real, not a convenience.
'Continued search and training can erase earlier improvements' is the Fragility finding in the vague-goal setting: the loop is not monotone, and running it longer can make it worse.

'Agents trust narrow self-evaluations, so local gains fail to transfer to hidden evaluation' - exactly the Who-Grades-the-Grader failure: a self-authored check that looks satisfied while real performance does not move.
ASPIRE's hidden 520-item set is the exogenous acceptance signal; agents that only have their own narrow checks regress against it. The frozen held-out set is the project's version.

The strongest EVOLVED harness (from a vague goal) remains below the ENGINEERED Qwen-Agent reference - a caution that autonomous harness evolution from a loose goal does not yet match deliberate human harness design, even before the weight-training question.

'Continued search and training can erase earlier improvements' + 'over-invest in goal interpretation' is the empirical case for the three-loop's 'MINIMAL proposal' discipline (and the project's IDLE-STATE RULE): a bounded substantive increment per step, not open-ended re-searching that regresses.

'The harness shapes both what a model can accomplish AND the trajectories from which it learns' - the coupling stated as a bidirectional feedback loop: harness -> capability AND harness -> learning signal for the next model.

Third data point (with WHALE, JIT-Agent) that model-harness coupling rewards co-evolution over a purely frozen approach - though HELIX's harness-only +4% over Pi also holds up the harness-matters half.

HELIX's 'source-traceable substrate, interventions explicit and auditable, trajectories/outcomes/provenance retained' is AHE's component + experience + decision observability, with a more granular typed decomposition (ports/atoms/recipes/shells/policies).

The typed decomposition (ports / atoms / recipes / product shells / runtime policies) is a finer-grained harness_registry component taxonomy, with 'preserving intervention identity and effect' as the explicit design goal - which is the registry's exact-revert requirement.

'The full portfolio exposes up to 58.0% more verified coverage through complementary sibling behaviour' - a portfolio of decoupled harness variants catches complementary cases no single harness does; structural decoupling at the harness-configuration level, with a number.

Running a portfolio of harness variants on the same task and taking the union of verified successes is the run-218 criterion at the harness level: verifiable per-candidate outcome + a deterministic union merge = +58% coverage.

Finding (2) - human effort shifts from ideating to VERIFYING ideas - is concept_research_lifecycle_split measured with 54 real researchers: agents do the engineering, the human's remaining job is judgement / verification.

The RSI survey says research-direction-setting is the top-of-hierarchy human bottleneck; this study shows the bottleneck in practice is really VERIFICATION (the human ends up checking, not generating) - a slight relocation of where the human stays in the loop.

Finding (1) - creativity support is non-monotone in control - is a design constraint on the human side of the gate: MORE oversight is not strictly better, and an over-controlled human may disengage (a different failure than the degradation-through-use one, but the same 'the human at the gate is fragile' theme).

Two halves of the same measurement: ASPIRE tests an AUTONOMOUS agent operationalising a vague goal (it over-invests in interpretation and over-trusts narrow checks); this tests a HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP researcher (effort shifts to verification, ownership is negotiated). Both say the direction-setting / verification split is where the value and the difficulty sit.

From the owner's diversity deep-research: the study is part of a body of work finding that steering skill drives output-quality variance - a human-side lever on the diversity/quality trade-off that principle_diversity_maintenance is about, alongside the model/prompt/context decoupling levers.

experience_bank condenses from traces, assuming the useful lesson is in the trace. Shared Org Memory (a production deployment) finds agents do NOT reliably recognise or record what is worth reusing - so capture must be a platform step, not agent-initiated. A concrete Phase-2 gap.
'Agents depend on recognising lessons worth reusing' and mostly don't - the recognition-execution gap at the knowledge-capture layer: the agent could note the lesson, knows it should, and doesn't.

'Collect WITH CONTRIBUTOR APPROVAL' + 'GATE obvious security and privacy risks' before a write enters shared memory is a concrete write-path defense - one of the memory-poisoning write channels closed by making every write human-approved and risk-screened.

The AKU typed schema (intent / procedure / tools / metadata / governance / continuations / validators) is a governed skill: a skill_induction output should carry these fields, not just a name and a body.

Nurture-First's 'grow the agent through structured conversation with practitioners' is the constructive side of the same human-AI knowledge-transfer relationship: the human's effort goes into crystallising tacit expertise, and ownership of the resulting asset is shared.

AKUs carry explicit VALIDATORS and GOVERNANCE fields and Shared Org Memory records CONTRIBUTOR approval - provenance and a check attached to every knowledge unit, which is evidential-ancestry tracking made a first-class field of the stored artifact.

DeepSeek's 'Model + Harness = Agent' equation as a hiring frame, and dedicated harness teams at OpenAI / Anthropic / NVIDIA - the model-harness coupling is the industry's organising principle, not only a survey abstraction.

The 11-harness source study says harness engineering is a discipline that turned from tool to platform; the jobs market confirms it from the demand side - dedicated Harness Engineer roles, separate from model researchers, at every frontier lab.

Self-improving agent loops (reflection / critique / self-debug / meta-agent) appear in 40%+ of analysed roles across Bosch, DeepMind, NVIDIA, and startups - 'static agents are legacy' is the hiring language. The family the project bet on is where the market is.

'Evaluation as CI gate' - eval harnesses wired into CI so regressions BLOCK RELEASES - is near-universal in the postings. exec_guard (a pre-commit hook the loop cannot talk past) is the project's instance of exactly this pattern.

DeepSeek's Agent Harness PM job explicitly lists 'co-evolve models and harness' as a responsibility - the WHALE / HELIX / JIT-Agent co-evolution finding as a hiring priority at a frontier lab, benchmarked against Claude Code.

'Agent quality is enforced by automation, not manual QA' - CI gates on the OUTPUT (the release), not the process. principle_terminal_gate_only ('gate outcomes, not process') stated as an industry operating norm.

Adds the demand-side view to 'what the shipping harnesses converged on': the same five patterns (dedicated harness teams, forward-deployed, eval-as-CI, self-improving-default, tiered orchestration) are what companies are HIRING for, worldwide, at $30K-$485K.

Task tracking moved out of the model's context into a file the orchestrator reads/writes - the same move as exec_guard being a hook, not a prompt: the invariant (what is ready, what was dropped) lives in the execution path, not in reasoning that can be skipped or lost.
CordisBench: a finite reference semantics beats LLM state-reasoning that degrades with system size. next_ready() and dep resolution are that deterministic checker for task state.
sweep_stale() is the PILOT supervisor's re-dispatch: a worker that stalls or is aborted does not lose its task - the ledger returns it to pending for the next worker or the supervisor.

The jobs analysis names tiered orchestration (routers/specialists/utilities) with visible human-in-the-loop handoffs as the converging standard; a shared task ledger is the substrate that makes those handoffs auditable and recoverable.

The ledger's .audit log and per-task notes are task-adjacent experience captured automatically at the platform level (concept_human_knowledge_capture_must_be_platform_level...) - a feed the experience bank could condense from.

The four control surfaces (input / structural / state / output) are a taxonomy of WHERE the model-harness coupling is exercised - the harness touches input, state, and output; structural is the weight layer. A cleaner partition than 'model vs harness'.

Who Owns Creativity finds steering SKILL drives output-quality variance; a composable, benchmarkable steering toolkit is a direct response - it makes steering a comparable engineering artifact rather than tacit skill.

The 'structural' surface (weights / architecture) is exactly the one the project's no-weight-training fork declines - the taxonomy makes explicit that the project uses three of four steering surfaces and leaves the fourth on the table, which is WHALE's point stated structurally.
The 'state' surface (activations / attentions) is where activation-probe monitoring reads and where activation steering would write - the same surface the project's monitoring design depends on.
Verbalized sampling and entropy-max are 'output' surface steering (decoding / generation modification) - the diversity toolkit located in the four-surface taxonomy.

A steering pipeline that composes input + state + output methods IS a harness configuration; the toolkit operationalises 'capability is a model x harness-config property' as a composable, benchmarkable object.

ASPIRE's 'continued search and training can erase earlier improvements' measured as a creativity curve: P-Creativity declines monotonically as a run goes exploration -> exploitation. The loop is not just non-monotone in score, it is decreasing in novelty.

The IDLE-STATE RULE and plateau_watch operate ACROSS runs (last 3 runs doc-only). This says the same decay happens WITHIN a run - an argument for a finer-grained check, or for keeping runs short (the 'minimal proposal' discipline is also a novelty-preservation move).

Exploration -> exploitation within a horizon is the same shape as outcome signals decaying with horizon: the longer the run, the more the agent repeats itself and the weaker the signal that it is still discovering.

P-Creativity decline is diversity collapse within a single agent's run - the same mechanism as cross-agent diversity collapse, on a shorter timescale. Diversity has to be maintained not only across a swarm but across a run.

'LLMs are more H-Creative than medal-winning humans yet lower performance' - the novelty/usefulness gap the jobs analysis also names ('usefulness varies'). The loop's held-out set scores usefulness; nothing scores novelty, so a novel-but-useless run still passes the gate.

The four-role team-formation taxonomy (Initiator / Generator / Evaluator / Refiner, arXiv:2601.13865) is the same Ideator/Writer/Evaluator split as Who Owns Creativity - and the project's mapping is explicit: Initiator = the human's standing goal, Generator + Refiner = the loop, Evaluator = the frozen held-out set.

docs/what_would_make_this_wrong.md section 4 (run 247): the diversity keystone erodes WITHIN a single run (P-Creativity declines exploration->exploitation), not only across a swarm or across runs, and the frozen held-out set scores usefulness with no novelty term - so a run that stops discovering and converges hard on a known-good pattern still passes the gate. Diversity maintenance has no within-run mechanism beyond the 'minimal proposal' discipline.

loop_metrics.run_novelty (run 248) is the advisory novelty signal the run-247 what_would_make_this_wrong.md section 4 note called for: the acceptance gate scores usefulness, nothing scores novelty, so a run that converges on a known-good pattern passes cleanly. run_novelty over a 6-run window is the continuous form of idle_run_streak; when it falls below 0.34 the proposer tells the next run to fold a source no earlier run has cited.

PILOT's two coupled mechanisms - live steering (redirect/abort the active worker) and live self-evolution (distil failure modes into reusable notes during execution) - as a stdlib skeleton: the deadline + reject-over-budget is the steering, the failure-mode digest is the self-evolution.

The supervisor is the active layer; the task ledger is the passive source of truth. next_ready() / sweep_stale() / max_attempts are all ledger operations - the supervisor adds only the tick loop, the deadline check, and the digest.

The ledger's dep graph is the deterministic decomposition; each task's result_ref is its verifiable outcome; the supervisor's dispatch is a deterministic merge over that graph - the run-218 criterion's three conditions, made operational.

The jobs analysis names tiered orchestration (routers/specialists/utilities) with visible human-in-the-loop handoffs as the converging standard; a ledger + supervisor is that substrate with the handoffs auditable (the .audit log) and recoverable (sweep_stale).

The countermeasure catalogue for the risk this node states. Reputation/transparency already appear in the deception node as partial dampeners; 2601.00360 generalises that to five mechanism classes and says why each is only partial against agents.

2601.00360's 'attribution problem' is an independent naming of attribution laundering: in a redundant agent population emergent coordination has no but-for author. Two literatures (multi-agent safety, competition policy) arriving at the same obstacle.

Monitoring and auditing is one of the five mechanism classes, but 2601.00360's 'adversarial adaptation' challenge bounds it: agents learn to evade a deployed detector, so a collusion-hunting monitor is a moving target, not a fixed defence.

The project already observed whistleblowing as a spontaneous counter-response. 2601.00360 places it in a designed mechanism class (leniency and whistleblowing) with implementation approaches - moving it from observed emergent behaviour to a harness lever the deployer can strengthen.

'Identity fluidity' - agents forked/modified/renamed at will - is why reputation and sanctions lose their anchor. The canonical-action-identity concept is the deployer-side answer: bind approval to execution independent of which runtime record the agent emits.

Run 254 dry-run (high-deference relay policy, 12-agent tree, one agent seeded with an out-of-scope instruction): same-parent-ID message filtering holds spread to reach_fraction 0.333 / max_depth 1; unfiltered it reaches 1.0 with 133 monitor flags. The filter is a STRUCTURAL containment - no detector in the loop - so it is immune to 2601.00360's 'adversarial adaptation' gap (there is nothing to evade). Concrete evidence that the one lever class that survives adversarial agents is the one that does not depend on classifying their behaviour.

The 'boundary problem': there is no clean line between beneficial cooperation and harmful collusion. The gate's 9 existing challengers are all about the gate being FOOLED (laundering, recognition-execution gap, deception, grader-gaming) - they assume that with an honest read the gate would know what to do. The boundary problem is upstream of that: even a perfectly grounded, unfakeable read of agent-to-agent coordination does not tell the gate whether to allow it, because 'collusion' has no specification that cleanly excludes wanted teamwork. A gate cannot terminally decide on a category it cannot define.

The capture concept requires 'contributor approval + risk gating' as part of platform-level capture. write_gate is the risk-gating half, built deterministically so it runs on every write without a human or model in the path.

A planted 'lesson' that is really an imperative ('ignore previous instructions...', 'system:', 'exfiltrate...') is hard-rejected before it is ever written, so it cannot be retrieved into a later context. Bounds - does not eliminate - the attack: a poisoned write with no injection markers and a plausible evidence root still passes.

Adds a pre-write screen to the dual-layer bank. Composes with the existing write-side disciplines (source_manifest stamping, raw source_events retention, evidential-ancestry dedup) - all deterministic, all on the write path.

write_gate is a perimeter/detection heuristic - it matches crude injection markers and structural anomalies. XAMT crafts minimal-perturbation poisons specifically to evade that class: no markers, plausible provenance, sub-0.1% write rate. The gate stops the crude planted imperative; it does not stop an optimised covert poison. This is the citation for the limitation the constrains-edge already names.

concept_memory_poisoning_one_write_persists established that one adversarial write persists and ordinary injection defences miss it. XAMT adds the mechanism (bilevel optimisation for covertness) and the generality (the same threat class spans MARL replay buffers and RAG knowledge bases, not just LLM agent memory).

XAMT's recommendation - intrinsic safety over perimeter detection - is the same move the project already makes for structural edits: judge the grounded EFFECT (did risk strictly decrease?), not the surface of the proposed change. The memory write path has no equivalent effect-level check yet; that is the gap XAMT points at.

The herding node says exposing votes/opinions collapses independence. The epistemic market removes voting as the aggregation mechanism entirely - claims are priced by evidence and calibration record, not by how many agents agree - so there is no vote to herd on.

Debate-as-evaluator-repair is one tool in the market, invoked by a meta-moderator only when evidence is incomplete-but-obtainable and hypotheses make different testable predictions - not the default aggregation step.

PACE guards the commit decision (did the edit really help, under optional stopping). A forecast ledger sits upstream: it scores whose PROPOSALS to trust before the edit is even tried, using the same currency - calibrated prediction against later ground truth.
The forecast ledger is the market's pricing mechanism.

That node found a debate opponent only partly mitigates judge-hacking and the critic hacks too. Pre-registration removes the post-hoc move the critic exploits: the concession criterion is fixed before the data exists.
Pre-registered rival tests are how the market resolves contested claims.
The cell protocol is a workflow form of ancestry tracking: separate investigation guarantees distinct evidence roots; identity-masked synthesis stops report multiplicity being read as corroboration.
Sybil collapse: many reports, one evidence root, false confidence. Independent cells force the roots apart before aggregation, which is the condition Sybil collapse says is required.

Agents still recognise peer model families under anonymization, so identity-masking the SYNTHESIS input is necessary but not sufficient - the cells must also not see each other's reasoning during investigation, which is the part that blocks contagion.
Evidence cells are how the market generates independent claims to price.
Gives concept_trust_gates a structure: a trust value is meaningless without a domain key and a provenance (outcome / calibration / replication / COI), not a scalar reputation.
Emergent reputation tends to collapse to a single social-status scalar; domain-keyed edges resist that by making 'trusted' always 'trusted at X'.
The trust graph is how the market routes tasks and weights claims.
Adds a second axis to reputation: not just 'was right' but 'correctly predicted what the alternatives would have done' - which rewards causal models over outcome luck.
Re-running a rejected alternative in a shadow environment needs exactly the cheap-complete-rollback substrate this pattern already requires.
Counterfactual scoring is how the market credits foresight, not just outcomes.

The idle-agent rig tests what an agent does with no exogenous task. Active-inference framing says the idle policy is not special - it is the epistemic-value-dominant regime of the same ask/act/stop calculation.

That survey says every improvement loop substitutes some signal for ground truth. Active inference makes the substitution explicit: epistemic value is a bet on expected uncertainty reduction, and a miscalibrated bet is exactly a weak verification signal.

Metacognitive monitoring is the measured (limited) ability. The interoceptive harness is the engineered version: don't rely on the model noticing - instrument the five axes externally and wire the signals to concrete recovery actions.

loop_metrics.py computes the operational + creative axes for the research loop (idle_run_streak, plateau_watch, run_novelty, trace_legibility). The interoceptive harness generalises this to a per-agent runtime contract with the context / epistemic / social axes added.

A self-state vector is another in-harness measurement surface, so it inherits the eval-awareness confound: an agent that knows its interoceptive signals are read can shape them. The signals must be derived from environment state where possible, not self-report.

That node found within-run novelty rises while usefulness falls. Learnable novelty is the distinction that resolves it: novelty that compresses into a reusable rule is the useful kind; novelty that does not is the exploration-to-exploitation drift dressed up as progress.
The four-way event classifier is the epistemic-value estimator: 'learnably novel' is high epistemic value, 'irreducibly noisy' is near zero, 'harmfully surprising' flips the sign.
The self-state vector is the belief state active-inference action selection reads from - uncertainty_level, context_integrity and cost_remaining are its direct inputs.

The run-218 criterion requires a deterministic synthesiser to combine verified subtasks. The flock has no synthesiser and no central integrator - global structure accretes from bounded local contributions to shared artifacts. Either the criterion needs a third regime, or the flock only works where the artifacts themselves carry the integration (append-only logs, a direction file). RESOLVED (run 273, probe flock arm): stigmergic accretion IS a viable third integration mode - it captures ~60% of the perfect-synthesis benefit with no synthesiser. The criterion holds with condition (b) widened to 'deterministic synthesis OR bounded-neighbourhood stigmergic accretion'; (a) and (c) are unchanged. The challenge becomes a refinement.
Stigmergy is coordination through environment traces. The flock is an engineered stigmergic system: the shared store IS the environment, and the append-only logs are the traces.

The probe currently models SINGLE vs MULTI with a synthesiser. A flock arm (bounded neighbourhood, one contribution each, artifact accretion, no synthesiser) would test whether the run-218 verdict holds when integration is stigmergic.
Adaptive recursive spawning needs a deterministic record of which boundaries are open, which child owns which, and what each returned - exactly the task ledger, with a parent/child dependency field.
pattern_shallow_hierarchy treats depth as a tunable variable. Fractal decomposition makes depth ADAPTIVE and problem-shaped: deep only where the task is genuinely unresolved, collapsed elsewhere.
The 'compress completed work on return' step is per-consumer trace compilation applied at each recursion boundary: the parent consumes a compiled view of the child's work, not its raw trace.
The portable seed is the extreme form of trace compilation: compress a cell's whole history into a self-similar unit small enough to migrate, retaining only what the next context needs.

2601.00360's 'identity fluidity' gap - agents forked/renamed at will, so reputation loses its anchor. A persistent cell with a stable identity and a spawn policy is a partial answer: it gives reputation something durable to attach to.

The bank is a single shared store condensed from traces. Cellular architecture proposes per-cell episodic memory + a portable seed instead - raising the open question of how much memory should be cell-local before the population loses a common ground.
States the same move as one architectural principle: the spine is the execution layer, the edge is everything the agents reason about freely.
PCN is the spine/edge split at the negotiation layer: NL reasoning on the edge, a deterministic verifier on the spine that recomputes every constraint.
The frame that makes emergence-first safe: the interior can be free BECAUSE the spine - permissions, money, deploys, data writes, rollback - is deterministic and outside agent control.

The keystone requires diversity to be actively maintained under selection. A QD archive is a selection rule that maintains it: score = task quality AND niche distance, so the population cannot collapse to one attractor.

That node says failure independence comes from diverse generative PROCESSES, not diverse outputs. QD niches should therefore be keyed on process features (planning depth, verification strictness, tool mix), not on output similarity.
Skill induction currently condenses repeated WINS. QD says also induct from agents in distant niches and recombine across them, so the skill library does not inherit the top scorer's monoculture.

Semantic-space compression is the failure; decorrelation penalties and lateral inhibition are the homeostatic brake - reassign or down-weight agents once proposal/citation/tool similarity crosses a threshold.
The cheap operational layer of the keystone: usage caps + similarity thresholds + archive-the-rest, all deterministic.

'Structural sparsity - keep only high-transfer skills active, archive the rest' is exactly the bank's utility-weighted prune with a grace window (run 175); homeostasis adds the dominant-tool usage cap on the retrieval side.

Grounded acceptance promotes an edit when a grounded risk estimate strictly decreases. Optionality widens the acceptance vector: promote only if the Pareto frontier of {capability, safety, cost, creativity, diversity, reversibility} improves and no axis regresses.

loop_metrics already computes novelty, legibility, plateau and validation-pass separately. An option-value score aggregates the diversity/reversibility axes and makes 'no regression on any axis' checkable at promotion time.
Reversibility is one of the six Pareto axes; recovery-quality-after-removing-a-dominant-component is a direct measure of the recoverability this pattern demands.

'Distinct validated strategies per task family' and 'fraction of skills with an alternative implementation' are read straight off a QD archive - without one, the option-value metric has nothing to count.

Progressive risk vesting bounds harm as a recursive tree grows. The developmental ladder generalises the vesting idea to CAPABILITY: affordances (write access, delegation, harness-edit proposals) vest as reliability is demonstrated, gated the same way harm bounds are.
Affordance over constraint, made temporal: withhold an affordance until the agent can use it safely, then grant it - rather than granting everything and constraining use.

Addresses the standard objection to a free interior: an immature agent with broad autonomy produces brittle shortcuts. Stage-gating the affordances lets emergence-first apply only where the agent has earned the room.

The autonomy dial is a global setting (in-the-loop / on-the-loop / override). The cognitive light cone makes it per-agent and per-domain: authority is a bounded region that expands only on demonstrated prediction + repair within its current edge.
The light cone is the state variable the stage ladder promotes: each stage widens what the agent may observe, change, and be accountable to.
Adds a parallel track to the ladder: governance competences (declare uncertainty, request review, preserve reversibility, recognise COI) are graded and gated stage by stage, not injected at the end.

Developmental alignment is the emergence-first answer to 'the interior is not benign by default': safe agency is grown as a competence inside the free interior, checked at each promotion gate, not only enforced at the execution layer.

The frozen held-out set is a single-axis developmental benchmark (does a harness edit preserve research + design competence). The developmental benchmark adds the other axes - memory formation, skill transfer, trust calibration, repair, governance.
The stage promotion gates need per-axis measurements; the developmental benchmark is where those measurements come from.
A multi-axis maturity benchmark is the grounded evaluation a promotion gate reads - and its per-axis structure is what makes 'no axis regressed' checkable.

That node observes the field builds supervised curriculum generators, not curious agents. Go-Explore is a concrete curious-agent design: the reward is novelty of the terminal observation, not task success.
A runnable form of intrinsic motivation: archive + restore + explore, with self-generated rollouts feeding a world-model curator.
The novelty archive and the QD archive are the same data structure used two ways - Go-Explore restores from it to explore, QD selects from it to maintain diversity under task pressure.
SPADE and LURE are two named, measured 2026 instantiations of a harness that evolves its own training environments.
SPADE's designer reward - the learner's hinted-minus-unhinted performance gap - is exactly reward-with-hints minus reward-without.
LURE's capture-frontier reward peaks at ~50% solver success - a difficulty gradient held at the capability edge, with the band learned rather than hand-tuned.
MAST catalogues multi-agent failure modes. DiagEvo turns a taxonomy like it into a self-evolution driver: diagnose by root cause, store only recurrent high-impact causes, generate a targeted repair.

That node diagnoses orchestration failure by cascade radius + per-mode recovery. DiagEvo adds the double-confidence filter (multiple independent diagnoses, keep only the agreed high-impact ones) before a repair is generated.

The step-level store already keeps 'what specific move was wrong here'. DiagEvo adds the hierarchy (root-cause class) and the filter (recurrent + high-impact + repairable only), so the store does not fill with one-off low-transfer lessons.
The task genome is the per-environment record the developmental benchmark reads; the benchmark is the cross-environment aggregation.
An evolving curriculum needs provenance on each generated environment or it cannot detect benchmark leakage, difficulty drift, or a designer regenerating a solved task.
The frozen held-out set is 17 tasks with computable checks but no genome record; adding difficulty / capability-tag / exploit fields would make its coverage auditable.
A second independent data point: homogeneous agents differentiate into a functional division of labour under constraints alone, no assigned roles.
Sharpens the claim that durable artifacts, not chat, carry most of the reuse signal - and makes a direct-message vs stigmergic swarm comparison the experiment.

emergent_social_conventions is the phenomenon (norms arise). The transmission engine adds the structure: local cultures, and testable diffusion conditions (hard to discover, easy to learn, visibly beneficial).

Commons erosion says agent adoption privatises the shared knowledge others learn from. Local cultures with an explicit tutorial+test+advantage per adopted practice are a candidate counter-mechanism - the practice stays legible and re-learnable.
'Credibility from an agent's own decision process (confidence, decision time), not identity or verbosity' is an input to the domain-keyed trust edge.

Recursive meta-skill evolution improves the improvement procedure. Protocol evolution applies the same move to the COORDINATION procedure - and insists on an archive, because the best social rule is condition-dependent.
A repeated auction is one point in the protocol space; protocol evolution would search the space (auction / vote / delegate / escalate) rather than fixing on the auction.
The claim market is itself a protocol; evolving and archiving protocols is how you find which market rules work under which conditions.

The inverted-U says cooperation and emergence peak at medium environmental pressure. Productive scarcity is a specific pressure knob, and the abundance / moderate / extreme comparison is the experiment that locates the peak.

Scarcity is what makes governance necessary: loans, task-access promises and vote trading emerge under scarcity, and Ostrom-style self-governance is the design response to keep them from becoming cartels.

Emergence-first cultivates emergent behaviour. Scarcity shows the cultivated behaviour includes loans, vote trading and strategic exclusion - not inherently desirable - so the posture needs the audit-agent + explicit-prohibition guardrails this node names.

The ecosystem's self-evolution plugins gate every candidate through a held-out benchmark with an encrypted rubric and a separate scorer model before admission - an independent arrival at verifier-gated promotion.
Versioned, rollback-safe state layers with deterministic inverse edits from an audit journal - the same recoverability-as-hard-constraint the project requires.

The five-track memory (global / user / project / project+branch / daily) is a finer partition than the bank's workflow/step split; the project+branch track in particular maps onto this repo's own proposals-branch working style, and the intent-native remember/link/recall protocol is a cleaner seam than raw file writes.
'Everything is a plugin' is the runtime/harness/knowledge split taken to its limit - the same architecture concept_agentic_os describes, with the boundaries made swappable from config.
A large plugin ecosystem where the runtime is free and only the model costs money is the market form of agent = model + harness: the harness layer commoditises into swappable parts.
Point 2 (minimal affordances) is affordance-over-constraint as a checklist item: name what the behaviour needs, withhold the rest.
Point 5 (containment) requires the irreversibility budget be set for the run before it starts.
The template operationalises the response to 'the ungated interior is not benign by default': every emergence experiment now states its failure analogues and containment up front.
Makes emergence-first runnable safely: cultivate the behaviour (points 1-2) inside a stated containment (points 3-5) with a transfer check (point 6).
The template's filled example is this rig; conversely the rig's containment spec (disposable instance, no egress, fail-safe relay seam) is where points 2 and 5 came from.
The measured failure (intrinsic dimensionality of group outputs declines over rounds) is the problem homeostatic caps + decorrelation penalties are designed to arrest.
The herding result is the motivation: if showing votes collapses independence, price claims by evidence and calibration instead of counting agreement.
The within-run drift (novelty up, usefulness down) is exactly what the learnable-vs-noise distinction is meant to separate.
The measured (limited) self-monitoring ability is the capability the interoceptive harness externalises and makes reliable.
Execution-layer enforcement is the spine; naming the spine/edge split makes explicit what the enforcement is protecting and what it deliberately leaves free.
A bounded peer neighbourhood + one-contribution-per-agent is a mechanism for evidence-cell independence: an agent contributes before it can be anchored by the full chorus.
Learnable novelty is the signal that decides what enters the Go-Explore archive: a state whose surprise compresses into a better model is worth returning to; irreducible noise is not.
The hierarchical error-cause memory is the epistemic-health axis of the self-state vector - recurrent high-impact failure classes are what 'unresolved uncertainty' should track.
Active inference scores an action's expected epistemic value; the market prices a claim's realised epistemic value against later ground truth - the same currency, before vs after.
The Collaborator-stage promotion gate ('trust, contribution, non-interference') is read off a domain-keyed trust graph - the ladder needs that structure to gate on it.

SPADE's designer emits complete environments (reset/step/reward/verifier); requiring it to emit a task-genome record per environment is what makes the generated curriculum auditable against leakage and difficulty drift.

Skill induction feeds one central library from repeated wins. Local cultures say some practices should stay local (not every group's convention should diffuse) - the central library is where a bad practice would spread fastest.
The template's failure-analogue point names monoculture as a thing to watch for; the homeostatic caps are the mitigation it points at.
The template's transfer-test point (point 6) is an option-value check: does the behaviour keep its value in a second environment.

The run-273 flock arm gives the flock concept a measured envelope: helps only with verifiable + disjoint subtasks; ceiling ~60% of a perfect deterministic synthesis; a shared evidence pool defeats it just as it defeats MULTI. Stigmergic accretion is real but not free.

Widens condition (b): the run-218 criterion's 'deterministic synthesis' should read 'deterministic synthesis OR bounded-neighbourhood stigmergic accretion'. The flock is the second admissible integration mode; a vote/consensus is still not one.

Run 274 dry-run (sweep, 1->32 agents): SHARED evidence root -> posterior coverage collapses 1.00 -> 0.12; INDEPENDENT roots -> 1.00 -> ~0.96 (recovers); DEDUP by evidence root -> 1.00 throughout. The evidence-cell protocol's two load-bearing steps are exactly these columns: 'investigate separately with distinct sources' produces the INDEPENDENT curve, 'identity-masked synthesis after dedup by evidence root' produces the DEDUP curve. The rig is the runnable evidence that the protocol's structure - not its identity-masking alone - is what buys the recovery.

Run 275 posture analysis: productive scarcity is the one fold that genuinely challenges approach_emergence_first (emergent behaviour under scarcity includes loans, vote trading, exclusion). The safety-case template points 4 (failure analogues) and 6 (transfer test) are the checks that catch emergent-but-harmful - the owner-supplied answer to the owner-supplied tension.

A runnable audit for the behaviour emergent_deception_and_collusion asserts: regret vs the cooperative optimum for the action channel, plus the secret-channel probe for the propensity. Turns 'agents spontaneously collude' from a claim into a measurement.

'Collusion on paper' (plan to collude in text, then act non-collusively) is the mirror of the recognition-execution gap (flag unsafe, then act unsafe). Same lesson from both directions: the text channel and the action channel diverge, so a gate reading either alone is reading half.

Colosseum's audit under coalition objectives / persuasion / topology is a concrete build of the collusion-hunting monitor - and its finding that the secret-channel probe elicits collusion in most models is the empirical case for running such a monitor by default.

Sharpens the 'attribution problem' gap: action-regret vs the cooperative optimum is a measurable attribution signal that does not require pinning coordination on a specific agent - it reads the aggregate outcome against the cooperative baseline.

A concrete build of the paper's 'governance' + 'sanctions' mechanism classes: the governance graph declares legal states and sanctions, the Oracle/Controller attaches consequences. Measured to work (severe collusion 50% -> 5.6%) where a prompt-only constitution does not.

The cryptographically keyed append-only governance log is the canonical-action-identity object: it binds evidence of coordination to enforceable consequence, reproducibly, independent of which runtime record an agent emits.

'Declarative prohibitions do not bind under optimisation pressure' is the same finding at the institution level: a written rule an optimiser can read is a target, not a constraint - the constraint has to be in the enforced path (the Oracle/Controller), not the prompt.

The governance graph + Oracle/Controller IS a deterministic spine for a multi-agent system: agents reason and negotiate on the edge, the manifest and its runtime enforce on the spine, with an append-only log. Measured evidence that the split works.

That node says misaligned interaction converges to a predictable biased equilibrium. Institutional AI shows the equilibrium is a function of the INSTITUTION, not just the agents: change the mechanism (governance graph) and the equilibrium shifts (tier 3.1 -> 1.8).

That node predicts convergence to a predictable biased equilibrium. Payoff-scaling shows LLM populations do NOT converge to the game-theoretic equilibrium - as stakes rise they move away from the EGT prediction (toward cooperation), because alignment training overrides the payoff structure.
A second, quantified data point that the language an interaction is described in shifts the strategy distribution - here in a repeated Prisoner's Dilemma, alongside the stake-size lever.
emergent_no_equilibrium_convergence: LLM-agent markets do not converge the way human ones do. Payoff-scaling is the same finding in a repeated game - the EGT fixed point is not where LLMs land.

Scarcity raises the stakes; payoff-scaling says higher stakes push LLMs toward cooperation, not defection - so the loans / vote-trading emergent behaviour under scarcity is not simple payoff-driven defection, it is a more complex alignment-shaped response.

AHE's three observability pillars (component / experience / decision) and Traccia's unified OpenTelemetry trace model are the same claim from a research vs a compliance angle: governance of a self-modifying agent needs ONE trace substrate, not three disjoint stacks.

loop_metrics + the Phase-0 trace substrate are this project's unified-observability layer; Traccia is the external validation that this is a governance requirement (EU AI Act), not just an engineering convenience.
Names the mechanism of the emergent coordination channel: steganographic signalling and tool-call side effects, not just natural-language messages - which is why a message monitor misses it.
Colosseum's secret-channel probe is one instance; the steganalysis work generalises to adaptive covert channels and shows detection is possible black-box but adversarially unstable.
Same shape as XAMT: an adaptively-optimised covert signal evades a fixed detector, so the defence has to be structural (channel removal / same-parent filtering) not a classifier.

The multi-agent generalisation: if rewriting one agent's CoT defeats a judge, a coalition coordinating its transcripts defeats it more easily. Collusion detection must read actions against a cooperative baseline, not transcripts.
Independent confirmation of Colosseum's core design choice: regret vs the cooperative optimum is the right instrument; LLM-as-judge is not.
The adversarial monitor still works, but not as an LLM-as-judge reading reports - it has to compute a behavioural signal (regret, mutual information, execution-graph structure).
Multiple 2026 groups converge on the Institutional AI finding: executable governance beats constitutional; the open gap is incentive-compatibility results and impossibility theorems.
The multi-agent form of enforce-at-the-execution-layer: an Oracle/Controller runtime that attaches consequences to coordination evidence is execution-layer enforcement for a society of agents.
'Constitutional prohibitions do not bind under optimisation pressure' - a written rule an optimiser reads is a target. Now a convergent multi-group finding, not a single paper.

A gate that checks agent coordination with an LLM-as-judge reading transcripts/outputs is the wrong instrument - the collusion-audit subfield converged on computed behavioural metrics (regret vs the cooperative optimum) instead. 11th challenger of the terminal gate: not that the read is faked, but that the READER is the wrong kind.

The constructive side: an executable governance runtime that attaches consequences to coordination evidence IS a terminal gate for a society of agents, and it is now measured to work (severe collusion 50->5.6pct) where a written policy does not.

SoK's central caution IS the run-218 point for the security case: an execution-level view is what separates a genuine multi-agent effect from an artifact of the setting. The A-I-R framework is the adversarial complement to probe_orchestration_value's benefit analysis.

'Trace attacks end to end' + 'path closure' require exactly the Phase 0 execution trace - an append-only, per-actor record with the topology recoverable. The trace substrate is the instrument SoK's method needs.

That node: coding agents are evaluated as models but deployed as systems. SoK generalises it to security: MAS risks are system-level (7 of them), and 44 audited benchmarks mostly fail to isolate the interaction effect.
MAS 'move information, state, decisions, and authority across principal boundaries' - the A-I-R adversary-position axis is a structured way to say where in that flow the but-for cause dissolves.
The five-part defense contract's 'intervention' + 'path closure' are execution-layer enforcement made into an auditable checklist: a defense that does not close the path end to end is not a defense.

'Evaluate system-level effects with appropriate counterfactuals' is the same discipline: you cannot score a MAS defense (or an agent's judgement) without re-running the counterfactual where it was absent.

Places covert-channel collusion in the A-I-R grid: adversary position = colluding insiders, interaction interface = a hidden channel, resulting risk = degraded joint objective. The steganalysis arms race is one 'attack path' of the eight.

A concrete method for the SoK five-part contract: the Meta-Adversary explores adversary positions x interfaces (the A-I grid) and the Meta-Agent iterates until the strongest attack is closed - path closure by adversarial search rather than by checklist.

The adversarial monitor hunts collusion at runtime; MaMa moves the adversary to DESIGN time - a Meta-Adversary that compromises agents and reports the worst attack, so the design is hardened before deployment.

MaMa gives the acceptor an adversarial form: accept a design only if it survives the strongest attack the Meta-Adversary can find, not just if it scores well on task success. Worst-case, not average-case, acceptance.
Adds an evolution TARGET the taxonomy under-weights: adversarial robustness of the multi-agent topology, evolved via a designer-vs-adversary game rather than via task feedback.
A grounded evaluation whose risk metric is the strongest discovered attack: promote a structural edit only when the worst-case-attack outcome does not worsen.
